messages.subject: indentation
messages.body_plain:
hi all,

For most cases, indentation works fine. However, I found there is one situation bothers me and I could not find a solution to it. This is what I get in Vim.

# I don't like this indentation.
microbenchmark::microbenchmark(
                               as_data_frame(),
                               as.data.frame()
                               )

# I have to manually adjust the identation
microbenchmark::microbenchmark(
  as_data_frame(),
  as.data.frame()
)

any suggestion on this? thanks.
yuejun

messages.subject: Re: indentation
messages.body_plain:
The indentation will be closer to what you want if you put in your vimrc:
let r_indent_align_args = 0
